about: LEDGER's storage map (advisor 196, his pick 17 Nov 12:43; RULINGS 17 Nov). Every folder LEDGER writes has a shelf, what it serves, its size, its expiry rule and where it comes back from. retention.py reads it (from 18 Nov); a folder not on the map is flagged in that hour's row and goes on his page after a day. Nothing of his is ever on the map. First made 17 Nov from production/research/disk/INVENTORY-F-2026-11-17.md and INVENTORY-C-2026-11-17.md; sizes are those readings.

C.note: LEDGER's folders mapped with sizes; nothing large on C:
